name: teardown
description: Exploded teardowns of any machine, device or mechanism, built from real dimensions: an interactive offline 3D page in the Browser tab (explode, run the mechanism, steps, x-ray, section), or a real Blender scene with renders and a film. It asks which you want, installs Blender for you only with your approval, and lets the community teardown skill reuse CLIO's browser.
